question: Should the remaining placeholder suppression be implemented as a Signal-specific delivery fix or as a new cross-channel `messages` media-placeholder setting?
rationale: Current main already fixed iMessage locally, while the remaining Signal behavior may be solvable in the transport layer and a global config knob is a high-bar product/config-surface choice.

options.title: Prefer Signal-specific fix
options.body: Keep existing defaults and repair the visible Signal media-only caption path with focused transport proof before adding a global config option.

options.title: Add global messages setting
options.body: Introduce a documented default-off suppression setting with schema, metadata, docs, and cross-channel tests if maintainers want user policy control.

options.title: Defer pending live proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a live Signal send proves which replacement body or attachment-only path is safe.

recommendation.title: Prefer Signal-specific fix
recommendation.body: Keep existing defaults and repair the visible Signal media-only caption path with focused transport proof before adding a global config option.
